## Prior phase-local complete FreeRTOS+CLI console-task production promotion

The authenticated console task `[0x00541600,0x0054171C)` is one closed
284-byte stock boundary with one real stored Thumb entry pointer at
`0x0054178C`. Production leaves that pointer unchanged, replaces the complete
entry with a generated `B.W` plus 140 Thumb NOPs, and directs it to seven
strict relocated source leaves. Those leaves separately own fill, state
initialization, registration, command processing, byte consumption, one
receive iteration, and the task entry.

The implementation is MIT clean-room G2 glue. It retains the stock
FreeRTOS+CLI interpreter ABI at `0x005847FE`, the 128-byte call boundary, the
22 setup-function order, and all 76 proprietary descriptors. The retained
interpreter, setup functions, descriptors, and handlers remain outside this
source claim. The production behavior intentionally reserves input byte 127
for NUL and consumes a received byte only when the retained ring read returns
exactly one; these are reviewed safety divergences from stock.

The former exact capacity patch at `0x00541708` and its appended two-byte leaf
are removed rather than left as unreachable duplicate ownership. The original
whole-task candidate and the authenticated MIT FreeRTOS-Plus-CLI snapshot are
excluded from all production registration. The snapshot's selected commit is
an openCFW compatibility baseline, not proof of Even Realities' exact source
checkout. The existing nanopb and CmBacktrace leaves are compactly repinned;
their code, dependency boundaries, license terms, and absence of a vendor
revision claim remain unchanged.

## Preceding FreeRTOS `prvInitialiseTaskLists` production promotion

The exact official Apollo-main helper `[0x0045568C,0x004556E0)` is 84 bytes
with SHA-256
`db9aad99c9dfd14cb9f2eb453dd86af05b11ed049eacf8771f25a82382894723`.
Its only incoming reference is the unchanged `BL` at `0x00454A20`, encoding
`00f034fe`; complete branch and stored-address scans find no other entry or
interior ingress. The six stock calls target `vListInitialise`; the body
initializes 56 ready lists plus delayed 1, delayed 2, pending-ready,
termination, and suspended lists, then stores the two delayed-list selector
pointers. The corrected call identities are termination at `0x004556C6` and
suspended at `0x004556CE`.

The source is the bounded MIT adaptation
`components/shared/freertos/runtime_freertos_task_lists_initialize.c`, 3,529
bytes / `58773452256b0f44647040085bbcc7a896a1cbd3efd0c5c4b4de3ddfe1a9e857`;
its header is 5,886 bytes /
`6fe827f6d2659a784e8b3e22fa096162dfd4003146c0425222efc92c63baef9e`.
The exact authenticated upstream slice is `tasks.c[150869:151768]`, 899 bytes
with SHA-256
`0908b0fb7a1b43d6d4fa2bd8212ba069ac6a8d4d036b4f973ae7f3baa6dd6e63`,
from FreeRTOS-Kernel V10.5.1 commit
`def7d2df2b0506d3d249334974f51e427c17a41c`.

The earlier prototype audit found a real C-language blocker: the candidate
used a local list structure tag in the declaration of
`open_cfw_freertos_list_initialise`, while the provider used
`struct open_cfw_freertos_list_initialise_list`. Production forward-declares
the provider's exact tag and explicitly casts each list address through
`void *` to that type at all six call expressions. Independent host and
Cortex-M55 combined provider/consumer checks are diagnostic-clean with
`-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -fsyntax-only`; the re-audit decision is GO.

Both toolchains emit the same 88-byte unrelocated text, SHA-256
`6710533445c9aac3904152a43147d0e9ba9bec7eff8e7c5c6b72007c4c301fdb`.
Its only executable relocations are six `R_ARM_THM_CALL` records at offsets
14, 36, 46, 54, 62, and 70, all to source-owned
`open_cfw_freertos_list_initialise`. Apple places the leaf at
`[0x007B28E8,0x007B2940)` and relocates it to SHA-256
`22d2909d84e02d0216a71168fdac379a576317c22dd5de6f527fb595c4668b52`;
all calls resolve to `0x007AEA2C`. Linux places it at
`[0x007B3004,0x007B305C)` with relocated SHA-256
`dd4a36cadf6346d513ec039724a2a58309f443d31aad4e50858c5a64d95c04f6`.
Neither profile inserts alignment before the leaf.

Production registers the exact symbol
`open_cfw_freertos_task_lists_initialize` and patch
`replace_freertos_task_lists_initialize`. Apple's full replacement is
`5df32cb9` plus forty NOPs, SHA-256
`fbd0478701f559ab96a24b759970640ffd17f30f20b36f7cb61e0e4173bf98dd`;
Linux uses `5df3babc` plus forty NOPs, SHA-256
`52fb57ebe49286360f1258cb2855a3b95abee1ed0a247e0cd3a3d6f6fc7d5e33`.

## Preceding nanopb `pb_read` production promotion

The official Apollo-main `pb_read` implementation occupies
`[0x0048F3BE,0x0048F454)`, component file offsets `[357342,357492)`. Its 150
bytes hash to
`69aecb900c749fd98bd2d05e2229e9a3d6829bd36f3e393f624e3579a9b4af7f`.
Whole-image Thumb decoding finds 15 direct calls: two recursive calls inside
the stock body and 13 external callers at `0x0048F632`, `0x0048F666`,
`0x0048F6C0`, `0x0048F6D0`, `0x0048F71A`, `0x0048F754`, `0x0048F764`,
`0x0048F7DC`, `0x00490198`, `0x004901B4`, `0x004903E4`, `0x00490478`, and
`0x004905A2`. Exhaustive aligned and narrow branch scans find no external
transfer into the 146-byte interior, and a bytewise pointer scan finds no
stored entry or interior pointer. The complete stock span is therefore owned
by one generated redirect while all callers preserve their ABI addresses.

Production uses the altered Zlib files
`components/shared/nanopb/runtime_nanopb_read.c` and `.h`, 2,874 and 2,059
bytes with SHA-256
`65f8f3cb92729e98f82f1254b18ba969cdd8a57c7ac74e8713137b5585102453`
and `aaa9847151722953498958687e91d55dc0b18cc9a60318b4f754110c66a443d6`.
They select authenticated nanopb 0.4.9 commit
`98bf4db69897b53434f3d0ba72e0a3ab1a902824` as a compatibility baseline;
the exact 814-byte upstream definition is source-identical in authenticated
0.4.7, 0.4.8, and 0.4.9 and does not prove Even's historical checkout.

The recovered 16-byte `pb_istream_t` layout is callback/state/bytes-left/error
at offsets 0/4/8/12. Both compilers emit identical 158-byte unrelocated text,
SHA-256
`06def086733fd9801b712161943b0da64e3b2bdf82e6f5962ee9207c738c00b1`.
Six strict relocations close over exactly three retained stock seams:

| Relocations | Retained seam | Fixed target |
|---|---|---:|
| `+0x1C` MOVW, `+0x20` MOVT | end-of-stream error string | `0x00787C70` |
| `+0x42` MOVW, `+0x46` MOVT | private `buf_read` odd Thumb identity | `0x0048F3A5` |
| `+0x86` MOVW, `+0x8A` MOVT | I/O-error string | `0x0078B690` |

No private error string is copied into the overlay. After relocation both
profiles hash to
`8b3de44a2cf7ca2e07715c913db0fa454ef65cbc453366190b12736e455aa7a8`.
Apple places the leaf at offset 124,640 / `0x007B2A04`; Linux places it at
126,464 / `0x007B3124` after two alignment bytes. Their complete 150-byte
patches hash to
`c2c44419ee24c41c8d0e8bc7f04689bb7f1c18b1f7ec3d7304e04c37579938a1`
and `4dc433588344c12d1a0abfab8c5f1673c24f6702d8f285f67fb0fd8b8e6e3eab`.

## Current G2 FreeRTOS TCB vendor-patch recovery

`components/shared/freertos/g2-tcb-v10.5.1.patch` records the complete minimal
layout delta over authenticated FreeRTOS-Kernel V10.5.1 commit
`def7d2df2b0506d3d249334974f51e427c17a41c`. It inserts one 32-bit creation
stack-depth word after `pcTaskName[32]`, mirrors it in `StaticTask_t`, and
assigns it in `prvInitialiseNewTask`. The patch is 1,730 bytes, SHA-256
`cf8c457153b75ad6a3163b9b6e6873e476e03537bb4534c9c8e4557de0eb4eb3`.

Four exact stock spans prove both creators use `0x70` bytes and the initializer
stores at `+0x54`; a Cortex-M55 compile of the patched upstream header proves
all later offsets through the allocation byte at `+0x6D`. The original vendor
identifier and private patch commit remain unobservable. This closes the TCB
layout as a source/ABI boundary but does not production-integrate wholesale
`tasks.c` or claim ownership of its remaining stock bodies.
